about: MIST v1.2 tracks ([Fe/H] = −4.00, [α/Fe] = 0, v/v_crit = 0; Choi et al. 2016, Dotter 2016), main sequence only (EEP 202–454), sampled by four/fusion/tools/mist.mjs from the packaged EEP files at waps.cfa.harvard.edu/MIST. Ages in Gyr since the ZAMS; L, R in solar units; T in K; ρ in g/cm³; Mcc in M☉. MIST includes element diffusion, convective overshoot, OPAL opacities and a mixing-length envelope; ours has none of the first two.
